notes_for_editor: Thin record. Status comes only from the FFLA county list. The 1964 USGS map sheet is the only dated source found that shows the tower; it does not say when the tower was built or removed. Elevation conflict not resolved: OSM node 353894354 gives ele 335 (metres), and a search snippet from aboutus.com gave 335 ft; that page was rate-limited and not read, so the record's 335.0 m is unchecked. The FFLA Wisconsin index also has a 'Birch Hill' tower (Ashland County, 47N-1W-30) that may be a different structure; it was not used. No source describes the site today.
